qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve wrapped headwear, dark tailored outfit, bronze hookah and hose; replace tiny boot crown emblem with fist. Cyan digital-device highlights require masking if visible; pocket device early, not recoloring. Review smoke keying, relay clarity and title.

Each handoff adds scale and force; the THIRD exhales a colossal orange fire-ring that slams outward through all three coils with a thunderous dominant BOOM and a sharp impact hold. Show three distinct sequential passes, not random particle spray. Finite warm-white/orange impact stars with clean cyan margins, no fullscreen flash.
4.8–6s: snap-zoom back toward his composed face. With a small wrist flick he collapses all three enormous smoke creatures neatly into the bronze bowl, as exact title PASS THE HOSE slams below his face in two powerful comic lines.
6–8s: whole-character hero hold, hose offered forward. One stubborn tiny smoke serpent peeks out of the bowl; he gives it a stern sideways look, and it ducks back inside with a small embarrassed puff. Face, costume and title stay stable.
